description: This file contains setup and configuration logic for the Nextcloud Talk channel within a larger plugin SDK, including validation, account configuration, and permission prompts.

methods.name: addWildcardAllowFrom
methods.description: Merges allowFrom entries with a wildcard '*' to permit all.

methods.name: normalizeNextcloudTalkBaseUrl
methods.description: Trims and removes trailing slashes from the base URL.

methods.name: validateNextcloudTalkBaseUrl
methods.description: Validates that the URL is non-empty and starts with http:// or https://.

methods.name: setNextcloudTalkAccountConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration for a specific Nextcloud Talk account.

methods.name: clearNextcloudTalkAccountFields
methods.description: Removes specified fields from a Nextcloud Talk account configuration.

methods.name: promptNextcloudTalkAllowFrom
methods.description: Prompts user to specify allowed user IDs for Nextcloud Talk.

methods.name: promptNextcloudTalkAllowFromForAccount
methods.description: Prompts for allowFrom for a specific account, resolving default account if needed.
